liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **How Sweet It Is (To Be Loved By You)** (2 reviews): Reviewer says this is the only version of this song and of Are You Lonely For Me; Reviewer says the Dead played this song only this once [9][11]
- **Looks Like Rain** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds Looks Like Rain pretty and clear despite the poor sound; Reviewer calls Looks Like Rain pretty nice, and also notes How Sweet It Is [15][19]
- **Mona** (1 review): Asterisks mark Mona, prompting a guest question about John Cippollina; Mona is inaudible on this version [18]
- **Smokestack Lightnin'** (1 review): Reviewer singles out a nice Smokestack Lightnin' and Sittin' On Top Of The World [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **Bo Diddley**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **I'm A Man**: rare: 3 archived performances [21]
- **I've Seen Them All**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **Take It All Off**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **Mona**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [21]
- **You Know I Love You So (Wo Wow Hey Hey)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **Slow Blues (unknown title)**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [21]
- **Pollution**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance; with false start [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-03-25.136684.sbd.sirmick.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 28 songs; 217 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Notes say you need to turn the volume up high [1]
- **gd1972-03-25.aud.hanno.horner.22094.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 24 songs; 139 min; rated 3/5 by 5 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer found the sound of this audience recording disappointing [20]
- **gd72-03-25.aud.hanno.8838.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 15 songs; 139 min; rated 3.2/5 by 15 [5]. Said about its sound: Many splices and glitches, with mixed sources of differing quality; Sound is poor but improves somewhat as the show goes on; Audience recording sound is poor [9][10][15][17][19]
- **gd1972-03-25.137696.s1partial.lee.hance.sirmick.sbeok.flac24**: audience recording; 6 songs; 30 min [7]. Said about its sound: Sound changes noticeably from 2:43 of Pollution to set's end; EQ was applied to match the start; Bands of noise at 8k and 16k were mostly removed [7]

## Around the show

- Guests: false start [1]
- Bo Diddley and the band played together for the whole first set [10]
- The set with Bo Diddley is described as a lot of fun [11]
- Reviewer reports a Hell's Angels party, with Bo Diddley playing in the first set [18]
- The Bo Diddley material gives the setlist an intriguing character [19]
- Bo Diddley joined the band for much of the first set; a Hell's Angels party took place [1]
- Show notes say the first set featured Bo Diddley [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-03-25.136684.sbd.sirmick.flac1648**: taped by Anonomous; transferred by SIRMick; source: Source: sbd > master reel > dat (48k) [1]. Also: Soundboard of the whole show, supplied by an anonymous source [1]
- **gd1972-03-25.aud.hanno.horner.22094.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Hanno Bunjes [4]. Also: Reviewer prefers Dick's Picks 30 over this audience source and plans to get the official release [20]
- **gd72-03-25.aud.hanno.8838.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience [5]. Also: The show has been officially released as a Dick's Picks, offering a much better copy; Much of this show is on Dick's Picks 30, in excellent sound; Dick's Picks 30 also includes the whole of the 28 March 1972 show [13][16]
- **gd1972-03-25.137696.s1partial.lee.hance.sirmick.sbeok.flac24**: taped by Ken and Judy Lee; transferred by SIRMick and John Jay Hance; source: Source: Audience recording > Sony S95 > Sony TC-124S > cassette Maxell UDXLII (1st gen); Recorded by Ken and Judy Lee; [7]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_90.html) [25]
- Poster by SF Rock Posters & Collectibles: [AUCTION - AOR 4.222 - Grateful Dead Bo Diddley - Hells Angels - 1972 Poster - Academy of Music NYC - Rough](https://rockposters.com/products/auction-aor-4-222-grateful-dead-bo-diddley-hells-angels-1972-poster-academy-of-music-nyc-rough?variant=48409166709015) [26]
